episodes.title: Charlie Big Potatoes
episodes.summary: When enigmatic genius Iris Nixon cracks a string of complex online puzzles, she is led to a piazza in Florence, where she meets charismatic entrepreneur Cameron Beck. He invites her to work with him to unlock a powerful and top-secret piece of technology.

episodes.title: More Than Zero, Less Than One
episodes.summary: In a desperate bid to escape the island, Iris blackmails Teo to botch the police investigation and help her flee. But when put under pressure by Krauss and Baptiste, Teo is given no choice but to betray her location, forcing her to make a death-defying escape.

episodes.title: Joy Ride
episodes.summary: Joy is taken captive by Baptiste, while Iris contacts conspiracy theorist Alfie and asks him to meet her in Rome to help her with the next phase of her plan. But with Teo being directed by Krauss, both Joy and Iris are delivered into the hands of Cameron for an explosive showdown.

episodes.title: Collider
episodes.summary: Iris is stripped of everything she's built. She escapes the island and contacts online conspiracy theorist Alfie, who arrives in Rome.

episodes.title: Ex Nihilo
episodes.summary: Iris uses her wits to get herself out of a corner and enlist policewoman Nico, while Joy meets mysterious genius Jensen Lind.

episodes.title: The Oblivion Suite
episodes.summary: Iris concocts an audacious plan to rescue Joy, involving a dramatic reunion with Cameron, then they are forced to flee with Alfie and Nico.

episodes.title: Two Seconds to Midnight
episodes.summary: Devastated by a setback, Iris makes a stand. Cameron's benefactor steps up control of his project.

episodes.title: Charlie Says
episodes.summary: Iris makes a potentially suicidal return to Caliburn. A showdown exposes the terrifying true purpose of the device.
